name: anc3_dft1
purpose: TASKS 291: the DFT step for 26 molecules of the anchor plan without a corpus row — psi4 deck v1 optimisation, then analytic B3LYP/ωB97X labels (pyscf 2.15.1) — so they can become CC anchors; batch probes/results_m1/anchor_dft_2026-11-21/anc3 (probes/corpus_opt_jobs.py, cheapest first), deployed by probes/deploy_opt_batch.sh. One lane of 4 threads at normal priority beside the CC wave (nice 19 would starve it behind 16 CC threads), each label under an 8 GB cap so the CC runs keep their memory. The wait condition is the batch's own ids.txt header: the run starts at once.
command: CODE=/root/dft1/modules/05_support_predictor/corpus LANES=1 THREADS=4 CAP_MB=8192 LABEL_ARGS='--max-memory 6000' bash probes/labels_batch_ccx53.sh /root/dft1 AD /root/dft1/ids.txt '^#'

estimate.basis: not measured beside a CC wave: ≈ 1–2 h per molecule at 4 shared threads (optimisation + two analytic Hessians for 10–18 atoms), 25–26 molecules per server
